what: For 01445 (fiber-boundary lint): blaze-query names `blaze_graph::sched::fiber` (lib.rs `sched::fiber`, `fiber::carry`, `fiber::Carried`, `fiber::current_job`; db.rs `blaze_graph::sched::fiber::Carried`; a doc link in db/local.rs). These are now re-exported from `blaze_graph::sched` (`sched::{carry, Carried, current_job, ...}`): switch to those, no behavior change. Then sched makes `fiber` pub(crate).
